subject: Future Tech
title: Level 5: The Ultimate Goal
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Level 5: The Ultimate Goal.

hook.text: Level 5: no steering wheel, no pedals, no boundaries.

buildup.text: Level 5 requires understanding every road, weather condition, and human behavior worldwide.

discovery.text: Most experts say Level 5 is decades away.

twist.text: We may not need Level 5. If Level 4 covers 95% of trips in cities, the remaining 5% can use human drivers on demand.

climax.text: The industry has quietly shifted its goal.

punchline.text: Perfection isn't the goal. Good enough, everywhere, is.

quiz.question: Why has the industry shifted focus from Level 5 to Level 4?
options: Level 4 in major cities covers most trips practically
